messages.subject: Comparison of two series in the same graph with ggplot
parts:
Good evening
I would like to be helped on a problem with my code
I would like to compare two series on a graph
 it shows error messages:
Warning: Error in data.frame: arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 44
And here is the code server.r and ui.r and helper.r


ui.r ; 

library(shiny)

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(shinythemes)

shinyUI( navbarPage(
  theme = shinytheme("united"),
  title ="L'INAC du HCP",
 
tabPanel("Plots",
         
         fluidRow(
           column(6, 
                  h4("Plotly: Visualize Top Sellers", align="center"),
                  h6("Change n-value to increase/decrease number of products shown.", align="center"),
                   
                  selectInput("data","Data", choices=c("data")),
                  uiOutput("u1",align="center"),
                   uiOutput("u2",align="center")
                  
                  
                  ),
                  
           column(6,
                  h4("ggPlotly: Visualize How Unit Price Relates to Sales", align="center"),
          h6("Select measure of sales total or quantity sold. Hover over points to see details.", align="center")
          
          ,        
        plotlyOutput("plotly")
          
           )
         
           )
         
) 
))


server.r : 


library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyr)
source("helper.r")

shinyServer(function(input,output)
  
  {
  va1 <- reactive({
 switch(input$data, 
  "data"=names(data1)
    )
  })
  
va2 <- reactive({
    switch(input$data, 
     "data"=names(data1)
           )
  })
  
  output$u1 <- renderUI({
    
selectInput("v1", "Variable 1", choices=va1())
    
  })
  
 
  output$u2 <- renderUI({
    
 selectInput("v2", "Variable 2", choices=va2())
    
  })
  

   for(i in 2:5)
  {data[,i]<- as.numeric(data[,i])}
  output$plotly <- renderPlotly({
    
   donne <- data.frame(date,data[,input$v1],data[,input$v2])
     
     econ1 <- melt(donne, id="date")
     
     ggplot(econ1,
            aes(x=date, y=value,colour=variable)) +
       geom_line()  
     
 })
 
})

helper.r
data<- read.csv("./data/file.csv", header=T)
data<- data[,-1]


thank you in advance

messages.subject: Re: Comparison of two series in the same graph with ggplot
parts:
First of all, I highly recommend you select all of your code in RStudio and hit Ctrl+i to auto-indent it.

Secondly, in this line:
It's likely this is being called while either input$v1 or input$v2 is NULL. See the article on req for the right strategy to deal with this.
